answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The sable of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The jade lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nectar is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
